alignment_check.note: This script never reads any precomputed *_va_nl_oof_*.npy file (grep-verified). Every VA_nl/VAT_nl OOF array is computed FRESH in-process, within run_arm()/fit_arm(), from V/A/y/groups/dense arrays that are constructed together (same function, same iteration order) for every cell -- so the 'bank item_ids order vs join/population order' landmine (mismatched precomputed OOF vs population row order) cannot occur here structurally. Cross-file joins (where the dense-prob CSV is a separate file from the bank population) are explicitly assert-checked at load time (see cross_file_join_asserts); adapter-based cells (nc_outcome, nc_agree, peer_curation, peer_revealed, hashtagwars_verdict) never join across files at all (single function call builds every array in lockstep). External validation: T_E computed here matches the independently-computed samerows registry auc_dense_heldout/eval/test figures (separate code path, rescore_dense_same_rows.py-family scripts) to 4 decimal places in every cell where a reference exists -- see t_e_vs_registry below.
cross_file_join_asserts: single adapter call (maps_batch1/cells.py load('nc_outcome')); y/groups/V/A/dense/dense_split all built by mapping the SAME `ids` list in one function -- no separate id-keyed rejoin possible
